subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: What Is a Mechanism?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is a Mechanism?.

hook.text: Every machine that moves has a mechanism hiding inside it.

buildup.text: A mechanism is a set of rigid links connected by joints to transmit motion.

discovery.text: One link is fixed to the frame. The others move relative to it.

twist.text: A single mechanism can turn simple rotation into complex output paths.

climax.text: Scissors, pliers, and car wipers are all mechanisms you use every day.

punchline.text: Links and joints — the alphabet of all machines.

quiz.question: What defines a mechanism?
options: Rigid links connected by joints that transmit controlled motion
A gear train with at least three wheels
